A Penguin PDF result was inspected and rejected because it was Albert Camus's different novel titled The Outsider.
person_note: The quotes repeatedly expose a nonparticipating narrator who moves among Ralph, Holly, Terry, Marcy, and other characters and reports their perceptions or thoughts in third person. Authorized excerpts independently show the same third-person base, while the whole-book study guide explicitly describes omniscient third-person narration across multiple characters. First-person forms in the quote set occur in dialogue, attributed reflection, or clipped local thought—including Rainwater's verified spoken line—and therefore do not constitute sustained first-person sections. No credible evidence of alternating or second-person base narration was found; the principal limitation is that the authorized excerpts cover selected sections rather than the entire novel.
